name: comment-rule
description: One comment checker for every repo and every point in the harness: a change must not add file:line citations or PR/issue/ticket history in comments, and every new comment line is listed for a reviewer to judge. CLI for CI and merge gates, plus write-time feedback after each edit.

interface.shortDescription: No file:line or PR-number comments; new comments listed for review
interface.longDescription: Counts comment lines with a real parser per language (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, SQL and dbt, shell) and compares a change against its base. The same checker runs in CI, in merge gates and after each edit, where it flags a prohibited form to the agent. Feedback only at write time; CI decides.
